fullTextEN: Hello, everyone.
I am Yvonne.
I am Taiwanese.

fullTextZH: 现在我住在台湾的宜兰。
fullTextEN: Now I live in Yilan, Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 今天我想跟大家说一个。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell everyone something.
It's something interesting in Taiwan.
It's about being vegetarian.
Hmm, being vegetarian.
What is being vegetarian?
Being vegetarian means you don't eat meat.
You can only eat vegetables.
Vegetables.
Hmm, like cauliflower.
Cabbage or spinach.
Many different vegetables.

fullTextZH: 所以你知道吃素是什么了吧？
fullTextEN: So you know what being vegetarian is, right?
You can't eat meat.
You can eat vegetables.
That's being vegetarian.

fullTextZH: 好，所以今天我想跟你们说一个在台湾很有趣的。
fullTextEN: Okay, so today I want to tell you something interesting in Taiwan.
A very special vegetarian culture.

fullTextZH: 你们知道在台湾我们有很多的寺庙。
fullTextEN: Do you know that in Taiwan we have many temples?
Right?

fullTextZH: 我们台湾人很喜欢去寺庙。
fullTextEN: We Taiwanese really like to go to temples.
We go to temples to pray.
This is praying.
Hmm.

fullTextZH: 如果我们有很想要的事情。
fullTextEN: If we have something we really want.

fullTextZH: 或是我们不知道怎么办。
fullTextEN: Or we don't know what to do.

fullTextZH: 或是不知道怎么做的时候。
fullTextEN: Or when we don't know how to do it.
We will go to the temple to pray.
Talk to the gods.

fullTextZH: 然后我们会问神明怎么办。
fullTextEN: Then we will ask the gods what to do.
Can you help me?

fullTextZH: 因为我们相信神明会帮我们。
fullTextEN: Because we believe the gods will help us.
I was a child.
When I was a child.

fullTextZH: 我常常跟我的家人一起去寺庙。
fullTextEN: I often went to temples with my family.
We went to pray.
Hmm, so.
I will see many people.

fullTextZH: 在很小声的跟神明说话。
fullTextEN: Speaking softly to the gods.
Hmm, but what are they saying?
I don't know.

fullTextZH: 啊，现在我长大了现在我长大了。
fullTextEN: Ah, now I've grown up, now I've grown up.
I know now, ah.

fullTextZH: 他们是在请神明帮他们的忙。
fullTextEN: They are asking the gods for help.

fullTextZH: 嗯？那请神明帮我们的忙。
fullTextEN: Hmm? Then ask the gods to help us.
What does it have to do with being vegetarian?

fullTextZH: 是因为神明也喜欢吃素吗？
fullTextEN: Is it because the gods also like vegetarian food?
Or are the gods also vegetarian?

fullTextZH: 嗯，这是一个很好的问题。
fullTextEN: Hmm, that's a very good question.
But I also don't know.
So why is it?
It's because we want to thank.
We want to thank the gods.
Ah, thank the gods.

fullTextZH: 因为很多人会跟神明说。
fullTextEN: Because many people will speak to the gods.

fullTextZH: 请给我一个很好的工作。
fullTextEN: Please give me a good job.

fullTextZH: 或是请给我一个很棒的男朋友。
fullTextEN: Or please give me a great boyfriend.
Or a girlfriend.

fullTextZH: 然后呢，我们会跟神明说。
fullTextEN: Then, we will talk to the gods.

fullTextZH: 神明，如果你帮我这个事情。
fullTextEN: Gods, if you help me with this matter.
I can be vegetarian for a year.
Or three years.
Or three months.
Hmm, or three days.
Very short, very short.
But that's okay too.

fullTextZH: 所以你要吃素多少的时间都可以。
fullTextEN: So you can be vegetarian for any amount of time.
Then? Maybe a month.

fullTextZH: 两个月，或是五个月之后。
fullTextEN: Two months, or five months later.

fullTextZH: 我有了我很想要的男朋友。
fullTextEN: I have the boyfriend I really wanted.
Or the job I really wanted.
Then I thought, ah.
It's the gods helping me.
I told the gods.
If you help me with this matter.

fullTextZH: 嗯所以现在我要开始吃素一年了。
fullTextEN: Hmm, so now I will start being vegetarian for a year.

fullTextZH: 嗯，这个事情我们叫吃素还愿。
fullTextEN: Hmm, we call this thing 'eating vegetarian to fulfill a vow'.
Eating vegetarian to fulfill a vow.

fullTextZH: 嗯，我没有做过吃素还愿这个事情。
fullTextEN: Hmm, I have never done this thing of eating vegetarian to fulfill a vow.
But.

fullTextEN: My friend has done this thing of eating vegetarian to fulfill a vow.

fullTextZH: 嗯，可能我认识了一个新的朋友。
fullTextEN: Hmm, maybe I met a new friend.
I know, hey.
He eats vegetarian.
Will ask him, hmm.
Why do you eat vegetarian?
Then maybe he will say, oh.

fullTextZH: 我在吃素还愿所以我吃素。
fullTextEN: I am eating vegetarian to fulfill a vow, so I eat vegetarian.
Hmm, very special, very cool, right?

fullTextZH: 在台湾，可能你会听到很多人吃素。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, maybe you will hear many people eat vegetarian.
It's because they want to thank the gods.

fullTextZH: 可是在别的别的国家嗯。

fullTextEN: America, England, Thailand, Japan, all are possible.

fullTextEN: In other countries, maybe it's because you don't want to eat animals.
Or don't want to kill animals.
So you eat vegetarian.

Everyone found out, so.
Now.

So.

What about you?

fullTextEN: If you are also a vegetarian, why is that?

Or.
